description: A network-management research project deposits replication results for autonomous flow routing with near-real-time quality-of-service targets. The public README says a Python control-plane simulator combined deep reinforcement learning, a lightweight SDN controller, flow-routing management and packet-node agents. A CURSA-SQ-based data-plane emulator generated traffic and queue behaviour. The described result spreadsheet has hourly traffic, end-to-end and path delays, path shares, background traffic and cost fields used for paper figures. Zenodo lists one public 1.7 MB ZIP and README under CC BY 4.0. These outputs could benchmark a routing or congestion-control simulation, but they are study results, not executable simulator code. The README names RESULTS.ods and a detailed PDF inside its described package, while the landing inventory lists only the ZIP and README. Neither archive nor spreadsheet was downloaded, so sheet structure and numeric agreement with the paper remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this routing benchmark.
name: Replication data of Autonomous flow routing for near real-time quality of service assurance
